newsitem.title: USA: Standard Pacific to dispose of unit.
newsitem.headline: Standard Pacific to dispose of unit.

text.p: Standard Pacific Corp Tuesday said its board of directors adopted a plan of disposition for the company's savings and loan subsidiary, Standard Pacific Savings FA.

In a statement, the company said it entered into a definitive agreement to sell substantially all of Savings' mortgage loan portfolio and has entered into a non-binding letter of intent to sell the remainder of Savings' business, including Savings' charter.

The letter of intent is subject to the completion of due diligence on behalf of the purchaser, completion of a definitive sale agreement and approval of the transaction by the U.S. Office of Thrift Supervision.

The company currently estimates that both the disposition of Savings under the plan and the operating results of Savings for the period through the disposition will not result in a significant gain or loss to the company.
The company did not identify the buyer.
